source.label_status: source-drill family with explicit anatomical hand; descriptor-assisted event nomination

source_event.source_time_convention: 120 Hz; absolute frame / 120; crop clock begins at first included frame
source_event.reason: A more compact initial right-hand guard, small net pelvis travel, and rising/circular withdrawal from a counter-response drill; same performer and punch family, not a new population style.

derived_terminal_timing.provenance: Derived recovery timing processing of this recorded-style variant; not another recorded style or runtime TTC variant.
